cautious_probe
</NAME>

<DESCRIPTION>
Cooperate initially, then make a single early probe after sustained cooperation. If the opponent ever defects, switch to permanent defection; otherwise continue exploiting consistently cooperative opponents. This retains protection against hostile strategies while improving payoff against unconditional cooperators.
</DESCRIPTION>

<CODE>
```python
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def policy(own_history, opponent_history):
    return 0 if len(opponent_history) == 0 else (1 if opponent_history.count(1) > 0 or len(opponent_history) > 5 else 0)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
```
